name: Costco Van Buren Depot, Belleville MI

fieldNotes.truckGate: Long divided entrance boulevard off Belleville Rd ends at a controlled truck entrance ~42.2636,-83.4924 with a peaked-roof check-in canopy spanning the truck lane; whole yard ringed by chain-link perimeter fence (confirmed in Street View). Driver reviews describe an organized check-in / dock-assignment process (~10 min check-in).
fieldNotes.guardShack: Distinct small peaked-canopy/booth structure over the inbound truck lane at the yard entrance, separate from the main building and from the employee office. Consistent with a staffed check-in point.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because a physical staffed gate canopy is present.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Gate-to-yard approach is a ~300m divided boulevard from Belleville Rd; easily holds 3+ trucks. Trailers observed staged along the boulevard apron.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Wide paved boulevard apron outside the inner yard gate where trailers can wait.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Paved holding area inside the entrance, trailers staged on the apron before docks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide divided entrance with large aprons and multiple lanes; ample paved width to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Cross-dock building with dock doors along BOTH long faces (north and south); counted well over 100 bays across both faces - banded 50+.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Multiple full drop-yard rows north and south of the building holding hundreds of unhitched trailers - banded 50+.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks on two opposite building faces (north face and south face) form physically separate dock banks, typical of a cross-dock.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage rows north (largest) and south of the building, separate from active dock aprons.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Van Buren Township, edge-of-town setting: adjacent wastewater plant, public softball park, farmland/wetland to the south, with a residential subdivision nearby. On Detroit metro's outer fabric - judged Rural per rubric's small-town-industrial tiebreak; low-confidence call.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs east-west just south of the property but is separated by a treed buffer with no visible spur entering the yard.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main cross-dock warehouse plus an attached/adjacent office-and-check-in structure at the NE; counted as 2.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Divided boulevard presents ~2 inbound lanes at the gate; exit similar. Approximate from overhead.
fieldNotes.scale: No distinct truck scale pad identified in the truck path; left false.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Hundreds of trailers across north and south drop rows and dock faces; 240 is a conservative honest estimate from the captured crops.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: ~180 is an estimate summing both long building faces; overhead resolution limits an exact count.

citations.claim: Active Costco careers requisition: Fleet Truck Driver in Van Buren Twp, MI (depot role).
Van Buren Twp tax abatement for Costco's 347,720 sq ft depot on a 71.56-acre site on Belleville Rd; Costco's 10th depot, opened spring 2015.

verification.rationale: Econ-dev documents the build (10th Costco depot, opened 2015); current Costco depot-role careers reqs confirm it operates today; construction hits are 2014 historical, not a future site.
